subtitle: Out Manila · Philippine Airlines
overview: Fly Philippine Airlines from Manila to Beijing for the Great Wall, Tiananmen Square, the Forbidden City and the Summer Palace. Ride the bullet train to Shanghai for the Bund and Oriental Pearl Tower, enjoy a free day (with optional Shanghai Disneyland) and fly home. Five nights in 5-star hotels; this is a shopping-stop package.
travelDatesNote: Departures from Manila, Apr 9–14 2027 to Apr 30–May 5 2027. The rate changes by date: an amount on a date is added to the base rate per pax. Seats are limited and confirmed at booking.

placeDesc.Water Cube: The National Aquatics Center built for the 2008 Beijing Olympics, seen from outside.
placeDesc.Bird’s Nest: Beijing's National Stadium with its steel lattice design, built for the 2008 Olympics and seen from outside.
placeDesc.Juyongguan Great Wall: A well-preserved section of the Great Wall at a mountain pass north of Beijing.
placeDesc.Wangfujing Walking Street: A busy pedestrian shopping and snack street in central Beijing.
placeDesc.Tiananmen Square: One of the largest public squares in the world, at the heart of Beijing.
placeDesc.Forbidden City: The vast former imperial palace of China's emperors, in the centre of Beijing.
placeDesc.Qianmen Street: A pedestrian street just south of Tiananmen Square with traditional-style shops, used here for free shopping.
placeDesc.Xianyukou Food Street: A lane of old-Beijing snack stalls near Qianmen, with free time to try local food.
placeDesc.Summer Palace: A former imperial garden of lakes, bridges and pavilions on the edge of Beijing.
placeDesc.The Bund: A historic waterfront promenade along the Huangpu River with colonial-era buildings and a skyline view.
placeDesc.Oriental Pearl Tower: A landmark TV tower in Pudong with its distinctive spheres, seen from outside.
placeDesc.Starbucks flagship store Shanghai: A large Starbucks flagship store in Shanghai, visited as a city-tour stop.
placeDesc.Shanghai Disneyland: Shanghai's Disney resort, offered as an optional full-day tour on the free day.
